title: IT Infrastructure System Engineer - Windows
description:
**Company Description**

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description**

Position Title: L3 Operations Senior Compute Engineer  
Reporting To: Compute Service Operations Lead, Environment Testing Europe  
Working Location: Coimbatore  
Shift Timing: 12PM – 9PM IST  
  
  
OVERALL OBJECTIVES:

As part of the IT Infrastructure Support Team for Eurofins Environment Testing Europe, you will join a growing international team to work on maintenance of newly deployed segregated IT User Zones and Application Availability Groups Cloud infrastructure. Your role will be to support daily Compute operations tasks in a complex hybrid environment in Azure Cloud and local HyperV infrastructure. You will collaborate with number of different IT Support and Delivery Teams on daily basis. It will require strong Azure & HyperV virtualization, AD, Security and Networking skills. Open mind and ability to cooperate with multiple individuals in a multicultural environment is essential.  
  
You will get an opportunity to drive Eurofins major IT Infrastructure transition and transformation across Environment Testing Europe Businesses.  
  
SPECIFIC ASSIGNMENTS:  
  
  
Manage, maintain and optimize Azure compute services as well as on-premises Hyper-V clusters and virtual machine infrastructure  
Implement automation and orchestration for deployment, scaling, and management using PowerShell  
Monitor compute infrastructure health, troubleshoot incidents, and execute root cause analysis to prevent recurrence  
Collaborate with cloud architects, network, and security teams, as well as application owners at the international corporate level to support compute capacity planning and optimization and best meet business requirements in terms of security, cost, and effectiveness  
Enforce security best practices and compliance requirements in cloud and on-prem environments  
Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code for both Azure and Hyper-V platforms  
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing within the compute operations team  
Maintain detailed documentation of operational procedures, configurations, and workflows  
Stay current with environment version updates, emerging technologies, and industry best practices  
  
  
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:  
  
An ideal candidate should have strong experience in all of the below:  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).  
5+ years managing compute infrastructure with strong focus on Microsoft technologies.  
Deep expertise in managing Hyper-V environments including failover clustering, live migration, and storage management.  
Solid understanding of Windows Server administration and networking fundamentals.  
Experience in administering and maintaining print server environments, as well as troubleshooting printing‑related issues in Windows environments.  
Experience with backup and disaster recovery strategies for both cloud and on-premises environments (preferably in Veeam backup environments).  
Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills  
Ability to read, understand and create technical documentation  
Very good command of English written and spoken  
Ability to present technical projects on meetings  
Proven experience with Microsoft Azure compute services  
Scripting skills in PowerShell; experience with Azure CLI and ARM templates is highly preferred.  
  
WOULD BE AN ADVANTAGE  
  
Experience in administering Linux server environments  
Accustomed to using ITSM tools (e.g. BMC Helix)  
Experience of monitoring tools (Site24x7, Grafana, etc.)  
Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and other Azure-native monitoring tools  
Experience with Azure DevOps or other CI/CD pipelines

title: Cloud Administrator
description:
**Experience:** 7–10 Years  
**Role:** Cloud Administrator

**Location- Bangalore, Coimbatore, Hyderabad**  
**Cloud Platforms:** Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Administrator with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS to manage, monitor, secure, and optimize cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in cloud operations, infrastructure administration, troubleshooting, automation, security, and cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities

* Administer and maintain Azure and AWS cloud infrastructure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and cloud services.
* Monitor cloud environments for availability, performance, capacity, and security.
* Configure and manage Azure Virtual Networks, Virtual Machines, Azure Storage, Entra ID, and Azure Monitor.
* Manage AWS EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, and related services.
* Implement cloud security policies, identity and access management, role-based access control, and compliance practices.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, networking, connectivity, performance, and availability issues.
* Manage backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability configurations.
* Automate routine administration tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or cloud-native automation tools.
* Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
* Optimize cloud resource utilization and costs through monitoring, rightsizing, and resource governance.
* Manage patching, upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and incident reports.
* Collaborate with DevOps, development, security, and IT operations teams to support business requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 7–10 years of experience in cloud administration, infrastructure management, or system administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud platforms.
* Good understanding of Windows Server and Linux administration.
* Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, VPN, DNS, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Experience with IAM, access policies, encryption, security monitoring, and compliance.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, alerting, incident management, and root-cause analysis.
* Knowledge of backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Exposure to Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools.
* Experience with IT service management processes, including incident, problem, and change management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or AWS Solutions Architect certification.
* Experience managing hybrid cloud and multi-cloud environments.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices.

Key Competencies

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to manage critical infrastructure and resolve production incidents.
* Good communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your Notice Period ?
* What is your CTC & ECTC ?
* This job is initially remote for 3-4 months, later hybrid. What is your preferred location- Bangalore, Hyderabad, Coimbatore ?

Experience:

* Total: 7 years (Required)
* AWS: 5 years (Required)
* Azure: 3 years (Required)
* Cloud Admin: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

title: Vice President - Product Engineering
description:
**Role: Vice President — Product Engineering**

**Location: Coimbatore/Bangalore**

  

**About AppViewX:**

AppViewX is trusted by the world's leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry's most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.

**Our Values**

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.

* **We Do What We Say:** We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering — and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy.

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

***Engineering Leadership & Culture***

* Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture.
* Set and champion engineering best practices — including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence — across all teams.
* Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership.
* Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning — rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work.

***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams.
* Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities
* Scope and author technical plans for complex, large-scale features spanning multiple teams and release cycles; accurately track and report project and feature status at the executive level and release management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance — to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery.
* Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale.

***Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools — to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle.
* Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities — including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks — into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line.
* Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI developments (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, etc.) and evaluate their applicability to AppViewX's product and platform roadmap.
* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

***Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

  

**What We Require**

***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

* Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and LLM integration — including LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Solid understanding of Platform Engineering principles — including internal developer platforms, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and developer experience (DevEx) optimization.
* Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices.
* Strong command of software engineering best practices — coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI/CD, build processes, testing strategies, and production operations.
* Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals.
* Proponent of TDD and CI — capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices.

***Leadership & Communication***

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
* Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery.

  

**Why AppViewX?**

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX's policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

title: VP - Platform
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**Role Summary**

The VP Platform runs the current infrastructure while building the target platform. This is an operating role and a transformation role.

The role keeps existing SaaS environments stable, builds the new cloud-native platform, owns the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline, establishes the security practice, and brings platform engineering discipline into the way teams ship.

**What This Role Owns**

* Current SaaS infrastructure stability.
* Target cloud-native platform architecture and operations.
* Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD platform foundations.
* Oracle to Postgres migration tooling, validation, rollback, and cutover support.
* Platform SLOs, incident response, on-call model, and environment controls.
* Security, network, access, secrets, WAF, and compliance readiness.
* DBA practice across Oracle legacy operations and PostgreSQL target operations.
* Platform team structure, hiring, standards, and capability building.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* Product roadmap or commercial prioritization.
* Domain business rules owned by Supply Chain, Core Commerce, or Digital Commerce.
* Architecture authority for bounded contexts, which sits with the Chief Architect and Technical Design Council.
* Program status governance, which sits with the Transformation Program Lead.
* Embedded engineering delivery inside domain squads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Operations**

* Own infrastructure across current and target environments.
* Define and operate platform SLOs.
* Manage environment provisioning, access, capacity, and decommissioning.
* Reduce cloud waste through shared infrastructure, capacity discipline, and retention controls.

**Target Platform**

* Build the shared platform foundation for Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD.
* Establish standards for deployments, secrets, networking, monitoring, tracing, and release automation.
* Make platform capabilities usable by domain teams without each team having to invent its own tooling.

**Migration Engineering**

* Own the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline with the migration engineering team.
* Define migration throughput, data validation, rollback readiness, and post-migration checks.
* Work with domain teams and Principal QA on parity, shadow, pilot, and cutover readiness.

**Security And Reliability**

* Build the security practice and baseline controls.
* Establish incident response, on-call, alerting, and production review practices.
* Drive SOC2 / ISO 27001 readiness where needed.

**Team Building**

* Lead a distributed platform organization across infrastructure, DBA, security, DevOps/SRE, internal IT, and migration engineering.
* Hire senior platform, security, SRE, and DevOps talent where the current team has gaps.
* Grow junior engineers into a disciplined platform practice.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, database operations, or cloud operations.
* Experience leading teams of meaningful size and mixed seniority.
* Deep experience in at least two of Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS, Kafka, observability, or security operations.
* Experience running production systems while modernizing them.
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS operations, access control, reliability, and incident management.
Hands-on comfort with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling.  

  

**Helpful Experience**

* Oracle to Postgres migration experience.
* Retail, ERP, POS, OMS, or e-commerce platform experience.
* Experience building a platform team from an early stage.
* Familiarity with .NET, Java/Spring Boot, and mixed-stack modernization.
* Compliance exposure, including ISO 27001, SOC2, penetration testing, or security audits.

**Benefits**:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development

Comprehensive health insurance coverage

Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC

Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.

Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events

Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

“Ginesys One” is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in

BGV will be conducted by a third-party agency, and any discrepancies or failure in the verification process will lead to immediate termination of employment.

title: Senior MuleSoft Integration Engineer / Technical Lead
description:
**Specialisation: Mule 3 to Mule 4 Migration**

**Location:** Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore  
**Experience:** 10+ years in IT, including 6+ years of hands-on MuleSoft experience  
**Work Timings:** US Eastern Time (approximately 6:30 PM–3:30 AM IST during US daylight saving time and 7:30 PM–4:30 AM IST otherwise)

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly experienced **Senior MuleSoft Integration Engineer / Technical Lead** with hands-on expertise in MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and proven experience delivering at least one end-to-end Mule 3.x to Mule 4 migration.

The candidate will lead the migration and modernisation of enterprise integrations connecting IBM AS400 / IBM i systems, Snowflake, cloud-based SaaS applications, and custom Microsoft SQL Server solutions.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring active development, migration planning, architecture, production support, code reviews, and mentoring of other developers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess existing Mule 3.x applications, flows, connectors, MEL expressions, custom Java components, and deployment targets.
* Plan and execute Mule 3 to Mule 4 migrations, including MuleSoft Migration Assistant (MMA) and manual remediation.
* Convert MEL and DataWeave 1.0 logic to DataWeave 2.0 and implement Mule 4 error-handling strategies.
* Replace deprecated connectors and transports with Mule 4 equivalents.
* Migrate deployments to CloudHub 2.0 or Runtime Fabric.
* Develop regression testing, MUnit testing, parallel-run validation, and rollback plans.
* Build integrations with IBM AS400 / IBM i, DB2 for i, RPG/COBOL programs, and data queues.
* Design batch and near-real-time data integrations with Snowflake, including bulk loading, authentication, and performance optimisation.
* Integrate SaaS and cloud applications using REST, SOAP, SFTP, events, and messaging.
* Develop integrations with custom SQL Server applications using T-SQL, stored procedures, and change-data-capture patterns.
* Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Mule 4 APIs and integration flows.
* Provide L2/L3 production support, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning.
* Apply API-led connectivity principles and publish reusable assets to Anypoint Exchange.
* Implement API security, monitoring, logging, retries, idempotency, and dead-letter handling.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines using Maven, Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Mentor 3–6 developers, conduct code reviews, and prepare technical designs and operational runbooks.
* Work with business stakeholders, architects, and vendors to deliver integration solutions.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in software or integration engineering.
* Minimum 6+ years of hands-on MuleSoft development and maintenance on Anypoint Platform.
* Java Knowledge is preferred.
* Strong production experience with both Mule 3.x and Mule 4.
* At least one completed end-to-end Mule 3 to Mule 4 migration.
* Expert knowledge of DataWeave 2.0 and working knowledge of MEL and DataWeave 1.0.
* Hands-on experience integrating IBM AS400 / IBM i systems, including DB2 for i, program calls, data queues, or flat-file exchange.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake connectors, bulk loading, authentication, and query performance.
* Strong SQL Server knowledge, including T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, transactions, and CDC patterns.
* Experience with REST, SOAP, SFTP, event-driven integrations, and messaging.
* API design using RAML or OpenAPI Specification (OAS).
* Experience with Anypoint API Manager, OAuth 2.0, client ID enforcement, TLS, and secure properties.
* Deployment experience with CloudHub 1.0 / 2.0 and/or Runtime Fabric.
* Experience with MUnit, Maven, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Core Java knowledge for custom components and troubleshooting.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
* Willingness to work US Eastern Time hours on an ongoing basis.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

* **Entertainment and Media:** Ticketing, box-office systems, venue or theme-park operations, loyalty platforms, guest data, and high-volume event traffic.
* **Hospitality:** Property management systems, POS, guest profiles, and loyalty integrations.

**Good to Have**

* MuleSoft Certified Developer – Level 1 (Mule 4); Level 2 or MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (MCIA) is an advantage.
* SnowPro Core certification.
* Experience with Anypoint MQ, Kafka, or IBM MQ.
* Exposure to Salesforce, Azure, or AWS integration services.
* Experience leading migrations with fixed cutover dates or vendor end-of-support deadlines.

**Important Candidate Requirement**

Candidates must have **actual hands-on Mule 3 to Mule 4 migration experience** and be able to explain the number of applications migrated, their individual responsibilities, and the migration challenges they handled.

Candidates with only MuleSoft development experience but no completed Mule 3 to Mule 4 migration may not be a suitable match.

**Interested candidates:** Please share your updated resume highlighting MuleSoft experience, migration projects, IBM AS400 / IBM i integration, Snowflake, and SQL Server expertise.

Pay: ₹1,060,000.00 - ₹2,390,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of total IT experience do you have?
* How many years of hands-on MuleSoft development experience do you have using Anypoint Platform?
* Have you worked on both Mule 3.x and Mule 4 in production environments?
* Have you completed at least one end-to-end migration from Mule 3 to Mule 4?

If yes, how many applications did you migrate, and what was your role?

* What is your current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period?
* Are you comfortable working US Eastern Time hours on an ongoing basis? The shift is approximately 6:30 PM–3:30 AM IST during US daylight saving time and 7:30 PM–4:30 AM IST otherwise.
* Are you comfortable communicating with business stakeholders and presenting technical designs in English?

Work Location: In person

title: Data Architect / Data Lead
description:
Data & AIOnsiteFull-timeID: REQ-43637

N2P Systems

Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 10+ years ₹12L - ₹15L Posted 1 month ago

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

This is a critical position, and we are looking to close the role at the earliest.

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect / Data Lead with 15+ years of overall IT experience and strong hands-on experience in data architecture, data engineering, and enterprise data solutions.

The ideal candidate should have progressed through hands-on data engineering/technical roles into a Data Lead or Data Architect position, with the ability to provide both strategic architectural direction and practical technical leadership.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are not purely architecture-focused, but have strong hands-on technical experience as a Data Lead/Data Engineering Lead and have grown into an architecture role.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Define and implement enterprise-level data architecture and data strategies aligned with business requirements.
* Lead the design of scalable, secure, and high-performance data platforms and solutions.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across data engineering, data integration, data modeling, and data management.
* Design and review data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data lakes, and modern data platforms.
* Lead technical discussions with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and senior leadership.
* Establish standards for data modeling, architecture, governance, quality, security, and performance.
* Evaluate existing data platforms and recommend modernization opportunities.
* Guide development teams on architecture, technology selection, coding standards, and best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex data and performance issues and provide technical solutions.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.
* Mentor senior developers, data engineers, and technical leads.
* Participate in architecture reviews, solution design, estimation, and technical documentation.
* Required Technical Experience
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in data technologies.
* Proven experience working as a Data Architect, Data Lead, Technical Lead, or equivalent senior data role.
* Strong hands-on experience in data architecture and data engineering.
* Expertise in data modeling, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Strong understanding of data warehouse and data lake architectures.
* Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT and data integration frameworks.
* Strong SQL and database development experience.
* Experience with one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with modern data technologies such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, or equivalent platforms is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of distributed data processing and large-scale data systems.
